description: This module allows the administration of Keycloak client custom Javascript using the Keycloak REST API. Custom Javascript policies are only available if a client has Authorization enabled and if they have been deployed to the Keycloak server as JAR files.

parameters.name: auth_client_id
parameters.description: OpenID Connect client_id to authenticate to the API with. Default: "admin-cli"

parameters.name: auth_client_secret
parameters.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with auth_client_id (if required).

parameters.name: auth_password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: auth_realm
parameters.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

parameters.name: auth_username
parameters.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: The clientId of the Keycloak client that should have the custom policy attached to it. This is usually a human-readable name of the Keycloak client.

parameters.name: connection_timeout
parameters.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API. Default: 10

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header. Default: "Ansible"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the custom policy to create.

parameters.name: policy_type
parameters.description: The type of the policy. This must match the name of the custom policy deployed to the server. Multiple policies pointing to the same policy type can be created, but their names have to differ.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: The name of the Keycloak realm the Keycloak client is in.

parameters.name: refresh_token
parameters.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the custom policy. On present, the custom policy is created (or updated if it exists already). On absent, the custom policy is removed if it exists. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production). Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Manage Keycloak custom authorization policy
  community.general.keycloak_authz_custom_policy:
    name: OnlyOwner
    state: present
    policy_type: script-policy.js
    client_id: myclient
    realm: myrealm
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_username: keycloak
    auth_password: keycloak
    auth_realm: master

return_values.name: end_state
return_values.description: Representation of the custom policy after module execution. Returned: on success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the custom policy. Returned: when state=present Sample: "file:delete"

return_values.name: policy_type
return_values.description: Type of custom policy. Returned: when state=present Sample: "File delete"

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Message as to what action was taken. Returned: always
